cards.mood: The piece establishes a somber, submerged atmosphere immediately, maintaining a consistent sense of weight and introspection throughout.
cards.palette: A sustained, low-frequency synthesizer pad acts as the harmonic bedrock, present from the very beginning and evolving slowly in timbre to become darker and more dissonant towards the end.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Heavy water weighs upon the chest
Silent giants sleep in ancient beds
Cold shadows stretch across the floor
Ghostly echoes drift from every door
[Pre-Chorus]
The pressure pulls the world inside
Where the light and silence hide
[Chorus]
Deep in the hollow of the blue
Weight is the only truth I knew
Breath is a slow and steady tide
Old memories begin to bloom anew
[Verse]
Iron ribs hold the spirit fast
Shadows of the surface fade at last
Muted colors bleed into the gray
The heavy salt washes the pain away
[Pre-Chorus]
Time is a stone within the chest
Finding in the deep a place of rest
[Chorus]
Deep in the hollow of the blue
Weight is the only truth I knew
Breath is a slow and steady tide
Old memories begin to bloom anew
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
A kingdom built of silt and bone
In the garden where the salt is sown
[Chorus]
Deep in the hollow of the blue
Weight is the only truth I knew
Breath is a slow and steady tide
Old memories begin to bloom anew
[Outro]
